cards.gloss_en: a place to sleep for the night
cards.ex_en: We found a cheap lodging for the night.
cards.ex_cn: 我们找了个便宜的住处过夜。

cards.gloss_en: a small narrow arm of water reaching inland
cards.ex_en: A narrow inlet cut into the rocky coast.
cards.ex_cn: 一道狭窄的小湾切入了岩石海岸。

cards.gloss_en: having openings at the knees
cards.ex_en: He wore loose, open-kneed trousers.
cards.ex_cn: 他穿着膝部敞开的宽松裤子。

cards.gloss_en: searching by turning things over
cards.ex_en: She was rummaging in her bag for the keys.
cards.ex_cn: 她在包里翻找钥匙。

cards.gloss_en: the destruction of a ship at sea
cards.ex_en: Only two sailors survived the shipwreck.
cards.ex_cn: 船只失事后只有两名水手幸存。

cards.gloss_en: a long narrow top of a range of hills
cards.ex_en: We climbed to the ridge to see the valley.
cards.ex_cn: 我们爬上山脊去看那山谷。

cards.gloss_en: having little vegetation; infertile
cards.ex_en: Nothing grows on this barren land.
cards.ex_cn: 这片贫瘠的土地上什么都长不出来。

cards.gloss_en: a bird of prey with a hooked beak
cards.ex_en: A hawk circled high above the field.
cards.ex_cn: 一只鹰在田野上空高高盘旋。

cards.gloss_en: a small, roughly built shelter
cards.ex_en: They slept in a small wooden hut.
cards.ex_cn: 他们睡在一间小木屋里。

cards.gloss_en: fast wild animals like large rabbits
cards.ex_en: Two hares ran across the field.
cards.ex_cn: 两只野兔跑过田野。

cards.gloss_en: sheets, blankets and covers for a bed
cards.ex_en: She washed all the bedding on Sunday.
cards.ex_cn: 她周日把所有被褥都洗了。

cards.gloss_en: stripped a place of its goods; looted
cards.ex_en: The soldiers plundered the village.
cards.ex_cn: 士兵们抢掠了那个村庄。

cards.gloss_en: a stretch of sandy ground or beach
cards.ex_en: The boat was stuck on the sands.
cards.ex_cn: 小船搁在沙洲上了。

cards.gloss_en: the female parent of an animal
cards.ex_en: The kid stayed close to its dam.
cards.ex_cn: 小羊紧挨着它的母羊。

cards.gloss_en: useful things that add comfort
cards.ex_en: The new house has all the modern conveniences.
cards.ex_cn: 这栋新房子有各种现代便利设施。

cards.gloss_en: fairly good; good enough to accept
cards.ex_en: The food was plain but tolerable.
cards.ex_cn: 食物很简单，但还过得去。

cards.gloss_en: a small cut made in a surface
cards.ex_en: He cut a notch in the stick each day.
cards.ex_cn: 他每天在棍子上刻一道痕。

cards.gloss_en: a tool with a pointed head for breaking ground
cards.ex_en: He broke the hard ground with a pickaxe.
cards.ex_cn: 他用鹤嘴锄刨开坚硬的地面。

cards.gloss_en: completely lacking something
cards.ex_en: The desert was void of any life.
cards.ex_cn: 那片沙漠毫无生命。

cards.gloss_en: in a way that seems like a miracle
cards.ex_en: He miraculously escaped the fire unhurt.
cards.ex_cn: 他奇迹般地毫发无伤地逃出了火场。

cards.gloss_en: sent away as a punishment; exiled
cards.ex_en: The king banished the traitor from the land.
cards.ex_cn: 国王把叛徒逐出了这片土地。

cards.gloss_en: certain; not open to doubt
cards.ex_en: She is an undoubted expert in the field.
cards.ex_cn: 她无疑是这一领域的专家。

cards.gloss_en: covered with a roof of straw or reeds
cards.ex_en: They lived in an old thatched cottage.
cards.ex_cn: 他们住在一间旧的茅草屋里。

cards.gloss_en: to trim wood flat with an axe
cards.ex_en: He had to dub the plank flat by hand.
cards.ex_cn: 他只能用手把木板砍平。

cards.gloss_en: twisting and squeezing tightly
cards.ex_en: She was wringing the wet towel over the sink.
cards.ex_cn: 她正把湿毛巾在水槽上拧干。

cards.gloss_en: mainly; for the most part
cards.ex_en: The team is chiefly made up of students.
cards.ex_cn: 这个队主要由学生组成。

cards.gloss_en: props or posts used as supports
cards.ex_en: They set two shores under the roof.
cards.ex_cn: 他们在屋顶下架了两根支柱。

cards.gloss_en: too shocked to think clearly
cards.ex_en: He stood stupefied by the sudden news.
cards.ex_cn: 这突如其来的消息让他惊呆了。

cards.gloss_en: spun thread used for rope or knitting
cards.ex_en: Grandma knits socks from thick yarn.
cards.ex_cn: 奶奶用粗纱线织袜子。

cards.gloss_en: cooked meat directly over heat
cards.ex_en: He broiled the fish over the fire.
cards.ex_cn: 他在火上把鱼烤了。

cards.gloss_en: to move down from a higher place
cards.ex_en: We began to descend the steep path.
cards.ex_cn: 我们开始沿陡峭的小路往下走。

cards.gloss_en: old form of shall used with thou
cards.ex_en: Thou shalt not lie.
cards.ex_cn: 你不可说谎。

cards.gloss_en: old past form of awake; woke up
cards.ex_en: He awaked to the sound of rain.
cards.ex_cn: 他在雨声中醒来。

cards.gloss_en: was inclined or directed toward
cards.ex_en: His thoughts tended toward home.
cards.ex_cn: 他的思绪转向了家。

cards.gloss_en: basic natural forces or instincts
cards.ex_en: The animal acts from natural principles.
cards.ex_cn: 这动物凭天生的本能行事。

cards.gloss_en: slowly and without hurry
cards.ex_en: They walked leisurely along the beach.
cards.ex_cn: 他们悠闲地沿着海滩散步。

cards.gloss_en: fumes once thought to rise and cloud the mind
cards.ex_en: The strong drink raised vapours in his head.
cards.ex_cn: 烈酒让他头脑一阵昏沉。

cards.gloss_en: old form of have used with thou
cards.ex_en: Thou hast done well.
cards.ex_cn: 你做得很好。

cards.gloss_en: suitable; fitting the situation well
cards.ex_en: That was a very apt remark.
cards.ex_cn: 那句话说得很贴切。

cards.gloss_en: suffering great pain or hardship
cards.ex_en: She looked distressed after the call.
cards.ex_cn: 接完电话后她显得很痛苦。

cards.gloss_en: to occupy or involve oneself in
cards.ex_en: He likes to engage in long walks.
cards.ex_cn: 他喜欢从事长距离的散步。

cards.gloss_en: came back to life or memory
cards.ex_en: The old memory revived in her mind.
cards.ex_cn: 那段旧记忆在她心中重现。

suspect.ctx: when I began to be sick, and a leisurely view of the miseries of death came to place itself before me
suspect.issue: 书中 leisurely 作形容词修饰 view，义为“不慌不忙、缓慢拖沓地(细看死亡之苦)”；现 gloss 的“悠闲地”带惬意/闲适色彩，回读“悠闲地审视死亡的苦难”语感相反、不通
suspect.suggest: 保留“从容地/不慌不忙地”，去掉“悠闲”这层惬意义，或补注“(此处指缓慢、拖沓地)”
